hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); if [ -z "$f" ] || [ ! -f "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.md) bin="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier"; [ -x "$bin" ] && "$bin" --write "$f" ;; *.go) command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && gofmt -w "$f" ;; esac
